title: Descent of the unmarked finite curve diagram
statement: Let f:X→S be separated and finitely presented, η a component generic point, K/κ(η) a finite purely inseparable extension, and L_i/K a finite family of finite separable field extensions. Let A_i→B_i→Spec L_i have A_i nonempty open and B_i smooth proper geometrically irreducible of dimension at most one. Given a finite surjection ν₀:∐A_i→X_η×K compatible with structure maps, there are U∋η, a finite surjective radicial cover g:V→U, and a descended diagram ∐Y_i→X_V with finite surjection ν, finite etale T_i→V, open Y_i→Ybar_i and smooth proper Ybar_i→T_i. There is a specified Spec K→V over S with cartesian comparisons for all A_i, B_i and Spec L_i, commuting with the supplied arrows. In addition the coproduct comparison and ν₀,ν form a cartesian square with a map X_η×K→X_V. Fibres of Ybar_i→T_i at every point above η are geometrically connected of dimension at most one. There is no marked-open hypothesis or conclusion. Empty families are allowed. proof.text: Reduce the base, transport the prescribed field extension across the reduction residue-field isomorphism and generic stalk-residue isomorphism, and apply finite radicial neighbourhood-model descent. Transport the base open through the reduction homeomorphism. Reduce the source of the cover, factoring Spec K through it. The comparison is surjective on stalks. The cover is finite surjective radicial, so its chosen point is component generic; the reduced generic stalk is a field and the normalized stalk map to K is an isomorphism.

Construct the directed system of affine neighbourhoods of the chosen point, including transition compatibility with their inclusions into the cover. Spec K identifies with its limit through the normalized stalk isomorphism. Every A, B and Spec L is finitely presented and qcqs over K, since the B are proper smooth over fields and the A are opens in Noetherian schemes. Apply finite-presentation chain descent, then transport its stage to the corresponding open subscheme, including the prescribed X base change and its finite comparison.

Use the finite closed-image neighbourhood shrinking theorem for the radicial cover to find an open downstairs whose entire inverse image lies in the descended neighbourhood. Restrict every object and arrow to this inverse image. Prove the object comparison squares and the coproduct comparison by pullback pasting and universality of finite coproducts. All morphism properties persist by base change.

A field-valued point surjective on stalks induces an isomorphism from its residue field to the supplied field. Cancel the constant-field comparison square to identify the curve with the corresponding fibre, using this field isomorphism and pullback pasting. Geometric irreducibility gives connectedness of every geometric fibre and homeomorphism invariance gives the dimension bound. Universal injectivity identifies every point above eta with one in the supplied generic diagram. For n=0 the indexed statements are vacuous.

theorem exists_unmarked_curve_diagram_model
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsSeparated f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (η : S) (hη : ∃ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents S, IsGenericPoint η Z)
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra (S.residueField η) K]
    [Module.Finite (S.residueField η) K] [IsPurelyInseparable (S.residueField η) K]
    (n : ℕ) (L : Fin n → Type u) [∀ i, Field (L i)] [∀ i, Algebra K (L i)]
    (A B : Fin n → Scheme.{u}) (j₀ : ∀ i, A i ⟶ B i)
    (q₀ : ∀ i, B i ⟶ Spec (.of (L i)))
    (ν₀ : (∐ A) ⟶ pullback (f.fiberToSpecResidueField η)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField η) K))))
    (hν₀ : IsFinite ν₀ ∧ Surjective ν₀)
    (hcomm : ∀ i, Sigma.ι A i ≫ ν₀ ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
      j₀ i ≫ q₀ i ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (L i))))
    (hL : ∀ i, Module.Finite K (L i) ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable K (L i))
    (hj₀ : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j₀ i) ∧ Nonempty (A i))
    (hq₀ : ∀ i, Smooth (q₀ i) ∧ IsProper (q₀ i) ∧
      GeometricallyIrreducible (q₀ i) ∧ topologicalKrullDim (B i) ≤ 1) :
    ∃ (U : S.Opens) (_ : η ∈ U) (V : Scheme.{u}) (g : V ⟶ U.toScheme),
      IsFinite g ∧ Surjective g ∧ UniversallyInjective g ∧
      ∃ (T Y Ybar : Fin n → Scheme.{u})
        (t : ∀ i, T i ⟶ V) (j : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ Ybar i)
        (p : ∀ i, Ybar i ⟶ T i)
        (ν : (∐ Y) ⟶ pullback f (g ≫ U.ι)),
        IsFinite ν ∧ Surjective ν ∧
        (∀ i, Sigma.ι Y i ≫ ν ≫ pullback.snd f (g ≫ U.ι) = j i ≫ p i ≫ t i) ∧
        (∀ i, IsFinite (t i) ∧ Etale (t i)) ∧
        (∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i)) ∧
        (∀ i, Smooth (p i) ∧ IsProper (p i)) ∧
        ∃ (σK : Spec (.of K) ⟶ V)
          (hA : ∀ i, A i ⟶ Y i) (hB : ∀ i, B i ⟶ Ybar i)
          (hT : ∀ i, Spec (.of (L i)) ⟶ T i),
          σK ≫ g ≫ U.ι = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (algebraMap (S.residueField η) K)) ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField η ∧
          (∀ i,
            IsPullback (hA i) (j₀ i ≫ q₀ i ≫
              Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (L i))))
              (j i ≫ p i ≫ t i) σK ∧
            IsPullback (hB i) (q₀ i ≫
              Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (L i)))) (p i ≫ t i) σK ∧
            IsPullback (hT i) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (L i))))
              (t i) σK ∧
            hA i ≫ j i = j₀ i ≫ hB i ∧ hB i ≫ p i = q₀ i ≫ hT i) ∧
        (∃ aX : pullback (f.fiberToSpecResidueField η)
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField η) K))) ⟶
            pullback f (g ≫ U.ι),
          IsPullback (Limits.Sigma.map hA) ν₀ ν aX) ∧
        ∀ i (s : T i), (t i ≫ g ≫ U.ι) s = η →
            GeometricallyConnected ((p i).fiberToSpecResidueField s) ∧
            topologicalKrullDim ((p i).fiber s) ≤ 1
